Subject: Vendor Compliance Packet: DPA signature, security report, and third-party roster

Hi Soojin,

We're ready to move forward with Redwood as a contracted vendor but procurement needs a few items on file before we issue the PO:

- Fully executed DPA (or a DocuSign-ready copy we can sign)
- A current SOC 2 report or a link to the hosted report (we can accept an expiring-access URL)
- The full subprocessor roster with country mapping

Can you confirm the expected turnaround for these? Our PO team needs the vendor legal name, tax ID, and the DPA on file to populate the PO; they will issue PO # after DPA is received. If there are any specific billing remit instructions for Redwood US vs Redwood EU, please include them.

I attached a short vendor intake checklist from our side (placeholder).

Thanks,
Eleanor
Eleanor Shaw
Vendor Operations | BrightGrid
infraops@brightgrid.com

Subject: Re: Vendor Compliance Packet: DPA signature, security report, and third-party roster

Eleanor —

Thanks for the clear list. Quick notes and next steps from our side:

- DPA: We can send a DocuSign-ready DPA. I'll route the standard Redwood DPA to you with signing instructions. If you need redlines, let us know and we'll route to legal, but that will add a few business days.
- SOC 2: We host an up-to-date SOC 2 Type II report behind a secure link; I'll provide a time-limited URL. If BrightGrid requires a full PDF in SFTP, we can coordinate via our security team.
- Subprocessors: We'll share the CSV export with vendor name, service, and country. If you need data residency flags (EU/US/APAC), mention that and we will include a flag column.

For the PO: please have Procurement include the following on the PO document so our billing team can match it: Redwood Inference, Inc. | EIN: 12-3456789 | PO to be sent to invoices@redwood.com (or invoices-eu@redwood.com for EU entities). Net 30 is our standard unless you request alternate payment terms.

I'll send the DocuSign link and the SOC 2 URL in a separate email within the hour.

Best,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Vendor Partnerships | Redwood Inference

1) PO needs Redwood's Tax ID to match exactly as listed on the W-9. Can you confirm the legal entity for the US PO (parent vs subsidiary)?

I'll upload the signed DPA to our procurement system and request PO issuance. Please confirm the tax entity and whether invoices should route to invoices@redwood.com or invoices-eu@redwood.com.

Eleanor / Procurement team —

Great — thanks for the signed DPA. Quick answers:

- Legal entity for US PO: Redwood Inference, Inc. (EIN: 12-3456789). Please reference this exact name on the PO.
- Invoice routing: For US invoicing send to invoices@redwood.com; for EU invoices send to invoices-eu@redwood.com. Our billing team will accept electronic invoices attached to the PO in PDF format.

If you need anything else (W-9, vendor portal access, or a contact for compliance attestations), loop in Laura and Rishi.

Best,
